# TV Cron Orchestrator — Scheduled Market Analysis & Position Management

## When to Use

This skill triggers when the user wants to:

- **Schedule recurring market scans** — run one or more TradingView indicators on a cron schedule (every 15m, hourly, daily, etc.)
- **Build a watchlist pipeline** — batch-run multiple symbols through selected indicators and aggregate results
- **Monitor positions automatically** — periodically check if open-trade directional bias still aligns with indicator signals
- **Set up event-driven alerts** — use Hermes hooks to fire actions when indicator output crosses thresholds (e.g. A+ grade detected, structure break, delta shift)
